ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 macro-ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-gray) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A monolithic dark-pigmented contiguous region occupying the central and medial fluke surface. High-contrast white geometric blobs are isolated at the extreme lateral terminal points (tips) of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with sharp vertex convergence and symmetrical bounding-box depth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular micro-serrations with varying pixel-amplitude; notable high-frequency jaggedness observed on the medial boundary of the right lobe and the lateral boundary of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral boundaries tapering toward the distal tips, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the terminal tips of both lobes; secondary discrete circular high-contrast spots identified on the mid-right lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization manifesting as irregular, high-contrast textural protrusions and pigmentation loss at both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Discrete, high-contrast white circular pixel groups localized in the medial-upper region of the right fluke lobe.
